subject: info-trns
title: INFO.TRNS.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 289 (WI-5). INFO-TRNS (information transference) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: AF-CON (affinity convergence). From AF-CON: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From PHY-U-P: AF-DT (affinity dictates) and AGT (agreement). From DYM-F: C-CONT (composite continuance). From AGT: POST (postulation). From C-CONT: INT (intention). From INT: IND-DY-RT. AGT has the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
